priorEntriesCounting: Overlapping source/audit/artifact arrays, not a unique-file count

postRunReadOnlyReview.scope: Inspected after final diagnostics; not included in the initial acceptance source-state or npm source freeze.

actualApp.counting: Recorded acceptance cases. Browser cases are included in overall records; do not add totals together.

npmTest.counting: Separate TAP invocation totals; not unique tests and not acceptance/live scenario counts.

unresolvedHistoricalBrowserFinding.meaning: A later per-run PASS does not establish the cause or prove a fix for the earlier pre-request editor-open failure.

limitations: Read-only SQL metrics cover declared tables/edges, not every JSON, storage, job or provider reference.
Deliberate local corrupt sentinels remain in baseline counts; no new bad links is not a clean production-data claim.
Protected API exposure failures remain explicit; registry/sidebar invisibility is not authorization proof.
Compatibility profile probes do not establish complete runtime traffic, a real observation window or zero usage.
Historical runs and screenshots are preserved; only finalRunId is the final source-bound acceptance run.
nextAction: Review measured defects and protected scope; retain HOLD until explicit ownership, containment and release/live prerequisites are satisfied.
